core_obligations: Show B ⊂ A and construct the maximal B-submodule E' of E.
Rule out nonzero maps G → E/E' with G in B via the extension argument on G' = E ×_{E/E'} G.
Run the induction on the minimal affine cover: the kernel E'' lowers n, and the base case uses supported-on-support-pre on U.
Conclude with G = φ^{-1}(E) in B mapping nontrivially to E.
proof_roadmap: maximal B-submodule + quotient reduction + induction on minimal affine cover
